title: Removal from state to federal court
shortTitle: Removal from state to federal court
summary: Removal transfers an eligible action from state court to federal court through a procedure authorized by Congress. It ordinarily depends on federal original jurisdiction and the removing party’s statutory role.
notes: A federal issue in a defense does not ordinarily authorize removal. The meaning of defendant matters in Shamrock Oil and Home Depot. Remand grounds and reviewability present additional questions.

sections.Meaning: Removal transfers an eligible action from state court to federal court through a procedure authorized by Congress. It ordinarily depends on federal original jurisdiction and the removing party’s statutory role.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the original complaint, the party seeking removal, the jurisdictional basis, the destination federal court, and the procedural requirements. Check consent, timing, amount allegations, and special statutes. Distinguish original defendants from plaintiffs or counterclaim defendants as the cases require.
